steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Just... a little bit... more.
She brings her power to bear against the Lord of Thunder, neither side giving the other leeway.
But this 'little bit more' is an insurmountable gap.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...As a miko, and as a lord, I have long since been ready.
She need only pay the toll with her life to bridge this gap.
A price she has always considered insignificant.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Watch over me, Mother.
So long as it is for Houei, for my duty, for my responsibilities.
Or if not for those things, so long as it lets Madam Orchid and Madam Catapult return home.
Then it would be worth it.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I must...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: slay the Lord of Thunder...
Hofukaru removes her eyepatch. Her right eye begins to shine with a dazzling brilliance.
The ultimate trump card, passed down through generations of miko. A technique to be used only when all other techniques have failed.
Using it consumes vast amounts of life force, and even a moment of inattention means you may very well forfeit your life.
But if you are willing to pay the ultimate price, a veritable explosion of energy will be your prize.
Energy gathers within her eye. Her vision begins to blur, to the point that she starts seeing things—
She sees two people who should not be here, standing in front of her.
They should not be here.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That's enough, Hofukaru.
Orchid holds onto Hofukaru's hand, gently pulling her out of the fog.
As for Catapult, she steps in front to shield her, as is proper.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Thou shouldst not have come. Everything I have done will be for naught!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: That hurts...
The Lord of Thunder slowly gets up on its feet, the shadow of its towering body eclipsing the hunters.
But Orchid and Catapult have no intention of retreating.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You were right. There's a girl who looks just like you, who hangs out with me and Catapult.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...But while you look the same, your personalities are the complete opposite.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: She—Popukar is like a little sister to me. She's timid, and never has her own opinion. With no one to pull her forward, she'd happily stand in place until the land comes to an end.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But I'm just her team leader while she's at Rhodes Island. I can't be with her forever.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: She needs to learn to be independent.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I don't want to tell her how to live, but... she needs to be able to at least think about what kind of person she wants to be.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You, on the other hand, are independent and proactive. You know exactly what you want.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I once thought it would be wonderful if Popukar could be even a little more like you.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But I quickly dispelled that notion. Because you are you, and Popukar is Popukar.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: And right now, it's you I'm hoping could be a little more like her. Learn how to rely on others more.

spans.text: I'm hoping could be a little more like
. Learn how to rely on others more.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Ye...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Next time you just wander off on your own like that, you're getting a harder thump on the head.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I... am not mistaken.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Even if ye had not come, I could have completed my mission.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What mission? No one's given you any mission.

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Alerted growl)

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Orchid, Catapult, get Her Meowjesty out of there first!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Why not?!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Take a look at the Lord of Thunder—

steps.name: Lord of Thunder
steps.text: (Howl of pure rage)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Is it helping us?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: There's a lot less black miasma coming out of it. Maybe its battle with Hofukaru cleared its head.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You're right! If it's not actually a bad guy, and it's got the former lord's power, it makes perfect sense that it sees the Hexhowls as the real threat!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Or it just sees those things as a bigger threat than mew guys!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'm not naive enough to put any faith in that theory, but we all heard the former lord's last words.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: She said not to be consumed by hate, and to use the Lord of Thunder's power.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...What?!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: How can that be?! Why would Mother...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: And even so, it hurt Midnight, and called forth the beast horde!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That sound—

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Samurai? Why would... Surely—

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Your Majesty.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Art thou alright, Midnight?!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Does he look alright?

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: He insisted on coming, so I had to use one of my machines to haul him here.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: There are so many things I wish to tell Your Majesty, but only one of them is important right now.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: The Lord of Thunder may not be behind all this.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Did you just say the Lord of Thunder saved you?

spans.text: Did you just say the Lord of Thunder

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: After I was caught in the blast, I found myself surrounded by Hexhowls. I thought myself a dead man, but then the Lord of Thunder appeared, and took them out in one fell swoop.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: What came after, I do not know.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Wait, so you're saying it didn't bring a bunch of Hexhowls to beat you up? Instead, it saved you then used the miko's power to purify them?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I fear... that is the case.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Upon awakening, I heard of Your Majesty's whereabouts and immediately set off to tell you this.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: So... did Mother really entrust her power to the Lord of Thunder?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...I must admit, it does make sense.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: If the Lord is not a spreader of the curse, but instead its victim...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: And if Mother knew the Lord instinctively preys on beasts affected by the curse...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Then the reason it is able to absorb the curse yet still live is because... Mother granted it her power.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Then when we saw the Lord of Thunder earlier, it was not the one triggering the calamity. It was simply attracted by it.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The true culprit behind all this is...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: the curse, or perhaps the Gyorin?!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Either way, it's not our enemy, right?

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Alerted growl)

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Good point. The Hexhowls seem to want to get to the Gyorin too.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: I don't know what they're thinking, but I'm pawsitive it's nothing good.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Whatever the case, if we wish to fully restart the Gyorin, mine own power will be insufficient. I shall also require my mother's power, that which the Lord of Thunder now wields.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Can't we just get it to help us?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: How?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: 'Tis but a wild beast.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Beasts have instincts too, y'know. At the very least, it knows what its biggest threats are. Why else would it be hunting down all those Hexhowls?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...She's got a point.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Even if it can't understand us, so long as it targets the biggest threat, it will naturally help us out.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Which means we have our mission objective. Right, team leader?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Team leader?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Yep!
Orchid sees Hofukaru and Midnight nodding along.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: We have a shogun and a lord here and you want me to lead?

spans.text: We have a shogun and a lord here and you want

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I... While I still believe in the rightness of my actions, I must admit thy methods may be better.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: At present, thou hast the superior judgment.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Had you not commanded my troops after my defeat, Houei could very well have fallen into chaos. Not to mention the courage your letter gave me. You may consider the Association at your beck and call.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: And if it weren't for Catapult's weapon, I'd never have been able to make my Suponosuke Dragonator. Just give the word, boss!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Err... Wait, your cannon thing ended up working? I thought you were just messing with us!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Of course it did! I keep telling you people, I'm a proper no-nonsense inventor!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You need to come up with better names then!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Your orders, Orchid.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I really do need to do everything around here...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Alright, I'll hand out combat assignments.
With the beasts closing in on them, the situation is dire.
Yet Orchid feels like her mind is clearer than ever before.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Our mission objective is to get close to the Lord of Thunder.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But not to hunt it. Instead, we're going to help it break free of the curse.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Midnight, you and your men are our vanguard. Open the way for the rest of us.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: It shall be done.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Suponosuke, you support Midnight.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: How?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: By blowing up as many things as you like.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Haha! That's what I'm talking about!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Catapult, you and I are on escort duty for Hofukaru.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Hofukaru.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Your mission is to...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Have no regrets.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...Understood.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: This will be a dangerous mission, so I hope you all know your limits.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Once we're done... I'll treat you to some barbecue.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Can't it at least be something fancier?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: If you don't like it, find someone else to lead you.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Eh, no thanks.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: It feels like it's been ages since we all got together.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: This is how A6 oughta be.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Didn't mew forget someone? What about me and Yoshitsune?

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Dissatisfied snort)

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: I want barbecue too!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Alright, alright, I'll let you handle the cooking. Happy now?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: I'll grill it to purr-fection!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Let's move.
